name: prove-build-works
description: Quality gate right after you build or change something: run it live on real data, try to break it on purpose, get a second pass by a different method, prove tests can go red, and end with a verdict that carries evidence. Use after building a script, skill, hook, routine, pipeline or fix, and before saying "done". Triggers: "/prove-build-works", "verify it works", "are you sure it's fixed", "test what you built", before any "done".
